title: Dreamer VNext TI-429 executable matrix
binary: mixed: release-native, mock-native, manual, web/tablet. Nothing in this file is device proof. Target: base com.tanuki75.noctalia / noctalia, no side-by-side flag. (Anterieur au 2026-09-04 : .qa retire.)
limits: This harness never launches Maestro, ADB, prebuild, install, commit, push or Linear.
npm run test:e2e:release:ti429:local executes only the release-ti429 suite. Other automated checks keep the command listed on the row.
release-native rows target an installed Release binary. mock-native rows use mock fixtures and are not Release-binary proof.
Failed analysis, quota and Plus/guest switching are mock-native. No real purchase.
TalkBack, contrast, large text, reduce motion, localization and mobile/tablet/web formats stay human checks and are unproven until recorded.
A 10_000-character paste is a documented human check because Maestro inputText is not a reliable 10k injector.
Unexecuted automated rows stay blocked in the plan. Manual rows stay manual. Neither is a pass.
Local Jest/typecheck proof is separate from device proof. Device proof stays in a dated maestro-results/android/ti429 directory.

Device proof runs against the base app com.tanuki75.noctalia / noctalia with no side-by-side flag. Record binary_source (local build vs Play), version and signature in each proof. Base device proof is local proof, not Store, Play install-source or purchase proof. (Anterieur au 2026-09-04 : side-by-side .qa retire.)

A compatible local base build may be installed when the user authorized native local testing, after verifying package/signature/version. Never uninstall or clear app data to force an incompatible install. Do not run purchase flows against a local binary. Auth-credential rows stay separately blocked when credentials are missing.

Guest real analysis stays blocked: Play Integrity eligibility of a sideloaded build is INDÉTERMINÉ until verified on device for PLAY_INTEGRITY_PACKAGE_NAME=com.tanuki75.noctalia. Precedent historique 2026-09-03 06:46:10Z observe sur sideload .qa (anterieur) : POST /api/guest/session returned 401 avec integrityToken, sans /analyzeDream. Do not attach an automated guest real-analysis command to any sideload. A package name alone never counts as integrity proof. Unblock only with a Play-distributed recognized/allowlisted identity, or an explicitly authorized authenticated test account.

TI-428 live-voice rows are manual or blocked, never a pass from this harness. Local stub AI at USD 0 is not 5-turn model-cost proof. Unmeasured p95/WER/cost stays INDÉTERMINÉ, not a latency-only no-go.
